messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: High GPU queue growth in eu-west2 (region) for inference-service-prod. Alert threshold breach (queue > 5000). Paging on-call.

maria (oncall): I'm on it, looking at autoscaler now.

maria (oncall): quick snapshot: queue length 6.8k -> 8.2k over the last 12m, 95th latency spiking to 2.4s per request.

jon: logs show repeated failures when creating GPU nodes: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T09:34:12Z autoscaler: node provision failed: QuotaExceeded: Insufficient 'NVIDIA_T4' GPUs available in project for region eu-west2
CausedBy: Quota limit (accelerator-cores) reached for project 12345
```

jon: GCE is returning quota errors, not transient provisioning failures.

tanya: any spare dedicated pools we can divert to?

ashok: Dedicated pools are full for EU. We have two leaky fallback options: 1) route traffic to cpu-quantized model (higher latency, lower cost) 2) fall back to a different region (latency penalty).

maria (oncall): Start with traffic shed to cpu variant for non-SLA customers and enable cross-region routing for enterprise tenants that allow it. I'll open a GCP case.

maria (oncall): tagging @cloud-ops — please open a support case and request GPU quota increase / capacity information. Include full project id and the attach logs.

cloud-ops: raised GCP case GCP-9543210, priority P1. GCP response ETA ~30m. Also checking if a temporary quota bump is possible.

jon: rolling a small configuration change to scale-down per replica memory requests to fit more pods onto existing nodes as a short-term packing optimization. Applying k8s patch in 2m.

maria (oncall): Command I'm running to limit model concurrency to reduce per-pod GPU memory and allow denser packing: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/generation-service MODEL_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 --record
kubectl -n inference patch hpa generation-hpa --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/maxReplicas","value":40}]'
```

tanya: after the patch, queue dipped to 5.1k but not stable; autoscaler still trying to create nodes and failing with the same QuotaExceeded error.

ashok: Suggest enabling local prefix/KV cache for repeat prompt patterns to reduce token generation demand. Pushing cache-on config to canary.

maria (oncall): Status page update in progress: 
status-bot: UPDATED: incidents.redwood.ai/incidents/2367890123 — eu-west2 GPU capacity constraints causing degraded throughput for some workloads. Mitigation in progress.

jon: potential quick workaround: spawn smaller GPU instance type (T4 -> T4-std) not listed as available; GCP reports region-wide accelerator allocation shortage. We're out of options for immediate new GPU capacity in eu-west2.

cloud-ops: Confirmed fairshare hardcap on project from quota review — other projects in org are taking the pool. We're requesting allocation rebalancing but that requires org-admin approval.

maria (oncall): OK, plan now: 1) continue packing densification + cache + reduce concurrency 2) enable fallback routing for non-committed traffic to cpu-quantized model 3) cross-region failover for paying enterprise customers (notify SREs in target regions first) 4) persist with GCP support and org-admin to request rebalancing/quota bump.

tanya: I'll start the fallback routing: pushing route rule to 30% of non-SLA traffic.

jon: Canary applied. Non-SLA traffic routing shows reduced queue growth by ~25% within 6m.

ashok: pushing cache-on to 10% canary as well.

cloud-ops: GCP responded: investigating resource fragmentation, asked for exact accelerator type + zone preference. They flagged a known shortage in eu-west2-b. Asking if we can accept other zones or preemptible GPUs.

maria (oncall): thoughts on preemptible/spot for non-SLA? Pros: faster allocation, cheaper. Cons: potential job termination and KV cache invalidation.

ashok: acceptable for background and batch reranks, not for low-latency synchronous inference. Could route low-priority workloads to spot GPUs.

maria (oncall): OK implement: route batch/rerank/backfill jobs to spot in eu-west2c and enable cross-region for sync traffic for enterprise tenants. Also coordinate with customer success for impacted customers.

jon: I've posted a short ops-runbook in the incidents wiki with commands and rollback steps.

tanya: handoff to next on-call in 30m. @ashok will be primary after me.

ashok: acknowledged, I'll take on the 30m->3h window. Will continue coordination with cloud-ops and status updates.

status-bot: NEW NOTE: Customers with dedicated contracts have been rerouted to eu-west3; public tiers see degraded throughput.

maria (oncall): final note before handoff: we've reduced customer impact by ~60% through densification + partial routing. Still working with GCP to restore normal provisioning. Pushing postmortem ticket: PM-2367890123.

ashok: taking over. I'll escalate to org-admin for quota rebalancing and keep the thread updated.

status-bot: INCIDENT: active — next update ETA 25 minutes.
